Uniqueness was asserted directly rather than assumed. THIS FILE is issue 5 of 15 as printed, `MASS WATER POOL 13*`, with its total row printed as `TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST`. (2) those 9 year columns sum to the TOTAL column the page prints beside them. Beyond this file, every figure in it also enters two further identities checked in `fy2019-p50-debt-grand-totals.csv` and `fy2019-p51-debt-issue-totals.csv`: the fifteen issues sum to the GRAND TOTAL row each page prints for that year, and the fifteen printed issue totals sum to the printed TOTAL corner. THE PAGE PRINTS DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the ROUNDED SUM and not the sum of the rounded parts. WHAT SAYS THAT RATHER THAN A MISREAD, and it is a contrast and not an assumption: the columns with no cents beneath them tie at ZERO. The two principal columns that do NOT tie are issues 02 and 07, Mass Water Pool trust borrowings whose principal amortises in cents. One wrong digit cannot leave that many independent sums perfect. NOTHING WAS WIDENED TO MAKE ANYTHING PASS (rule 14): every declared tolerance is stated with its derivation -- N displayed addends can differ from the rounded sum by at most N/2 + 0.5 -- and the observed maximum is given beside it. The observed maximum on this issue is $2. THE TWO KNOWN DEFECTS OF THIS TABLE FAMILY WERE LOOKED FOR AND NEITHER IS PRESENT IN FY2019, read rather than assumed. (1) FY2011, FY2013 and FY2014 each print a `MASS WATER POOL 9*` row carrying a FY2024 principal of $418,704 with NO interest cell and NO total cell, which makes those schedules contradict themselves by $418,704. FY2019 prints the SAME balloon payment and prints it COMPLETE: p49 FY2024 reads PRINCIPAL $418,704, INTEREST $0, ADMIN FEE $314, TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST $419,018, and 418,704 + 0 + 314 = 419,018 exactly. Nothing on these pages omits a component. (2) FY2015 excludes two school-construction issues from every year column of its printed grand totals while including them in the TOTAL column. FY2019 does not: the fifteen issues sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL row in 25 of 28 years exactly and in the other three by $1, and to the printed corner within $2 on 213 displayed addends. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the schedule is a repayment SCHEDULE, not a ledger. It states what the town expects to pay and when; it is not a record of what was paid, and no cents are published anywhere on these four pages, so no figure here can be reconciled to the accounting system. Rule 11 applies to every line: these are gross debt service amounts and the footnote says in the town’s own words that the Mass Water Pollution Abatement Trust payments are `TO BE SUBSIDIZED BY EQUITY EARNINGS AND CONTRACT ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS` -- so what the town actually raises against those lines is smaller than what is printed, by an amount this document does not state.
